entities.name: Heteroaromatic carboxylic acid
observations: Contains a carboxylic acid intended for amide coupling.

entities.name: Morpholine
observations: Amine component is morpholine, represented as C1COCCN1.
Acts as the nucleophile forming the carboxamide.

entities.name: Cyclic phosphoric anhydride
observations: Cyclic phosphoric anhydride is identified as the carboxylic-acid activation/coupling reagent.

entities.name: Triethylamine
observations: Triethylamine is identified as the base used in the coupling reaction.

entities.name: Morpholine carboxamide product
observations: This is the morpholine amide obtained by replacing the acid OH with N-morpholine.
Reported empirical yield is approximately 77%, with THF at 0 °C for 8 hours.

entities.name: Amide coupling of heteroaromatic acid with morpholine
observations: The reaction class is activation of a heteroaromatic carboxylic acid followed by coupling with morpholine to form an N-morpholine carboxamide.

entities.name: THF, 0 °C, 8 h
observations: The matched empirical record reports THF solvent, 0 °C, and 8 hours; approximate isolated yield is 77%.
